subject: MAP: Final evaluation checklist & hosting mode escalation
messages:
From: Rachel Cohen <rachel.cohen@helixhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Lewis <tim.lewis@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and hosting evaluation 

Dylan — thanks for the MAP doc last week. Our security team and infra lead ran a quick gap analysis and came back with two blockers that steer us away from hosted for now: (1) encrypted logging retention requirements that need a customer-managed KMS and (2) an audit log chain-of-custody for at least 3 years.

We still want the performance and the low ops overhead you showed, but those compliance asks are driving us to consider Dedicated or Private. Procurement is also asking for a firm go/no-go by Friday 12/31 to hit our Q1 budget cycle.

Can you share a final checklist of what Redwood needs to deliver for a Dedicated deployment vs Private (on-prem or VPC) — incl. timeline, security evidence, and any incremental costs? Also, what would the cutover path look like if we begin on Dedicated and later move to Private?

—Rachel
Helix Health — Sr. Product
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Cohen <rachel.cohen@helixhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and hosting evaluation

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. High level answers up front, then an attached checklist in the MAP: 

- Dedicated covers KMS integration for customer-managed keys (we support AWS KMS/GCP KMS/Azure Key Vault for dedicated pools). It also provides isolated GPU pools and audit log shipping into your storage.
- Private (VPC/private control plane or on-prem) is our fastest path to satisfy a strict chain-of-custody and 3-year retention.
- Cutover path: we can onboard you to Dedicated first (2–4 weeks) with a migration plan to Private that revalidates keys, re-provisions model-serving instances, and reconfigures routing. The migration is typically 1–2 weeks of ops work + testing.

I'm attaching: helix_map_v3.pdf (MAP with checklist + deliverables), redwood-hosting-comparison.xlsx (delta costs + timeline), and a security evidence summary.

Key asks for us to finalize estimates by 12/31:
1) Confirm P0 compliance items (KMS + audit retention) — which one is negotiable vs absolute?
2) Confirm expected Q1 throughput (rps / peak concurrent sessions) so we size dedicated pools.
3) Approve a 2-week dedicated onboarding window starting as early as Jan 4 if you want Dedicated first.

I'll follow up with Karthik and Irene to provide exact runbook snippets and an ops-level migration plan.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Cohen <rachel.cohen@helixhealth.com>, Tim Lewis <tim.lewis@helixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Final evaluation checklist & hosting mode escalation

Team — quick technical summary for the MAP response (internal + customer-friendly):

1) Dedicated: supports customer-managed KMS for token encryption at rest, audit log export (syslog/S3), and isolated tenant pools. Typical onboarding (for Helix sizing) = 2–3 weeks (capacity + routing + smoke tests).
2) Private (VPC): control plane changes + VPC peering or private link; onboarding 3–4 weeks. Private on-prem package: 4–6 weeks (depending on site access and HSM integration).
3) Cutover details: validate model artifact parity -> export KV cache migration plan -> switch DNS + canary traffic -> rollback window 48 hours. We provide a documented rollback and fallback to hosted-compatible model variants during migration.

I'll draft the ops-runbook snippets and a short appendix on KMS/HSM options. Suggest we offer Helix a short exec-level credit if they commit to Dedicated by 12/31 to cover unexpected integration effort — propose $15k credit off first 3 months of Dedicated usage. Thoughts?

-Karthik
From: Rachel Cohen <rachel.cohen@helixhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Lewis <tim.lewis@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Final evaluation checklist & hosting mode escalation

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications: 
- The 3-year audit log retention is non-negotiable for our compliance office. It must be customer-controlled or verifiable via an immutable export.
- The KMS requirement is flexible to using our cloud KMS if Dedicated can host the keys there. On-prem HSM would be preferred but is not mandatory.
- The proposed $15k credit is a helpful gesture — procurement will need it on paper with a short justification statement.

Next steps from our side before 12/31: we will confirm Q1 throughput numbers (likely 120 rps sustained, 420 rps peak bursts) and confirm internal sign-off on starting Dedicated on Jan 4. I need a short paragraph for procurement explaining the migration path and fallback options so we can attach it to the purchase order.

—Rachel
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Cohen <rachel.cohen@helixhealth.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Final evaluation checklist & hosting mode escalation

Rachel — thanks. Below is a concise paragraph you can hand to procurement (feel free to paste):

"Redwood Inference will onboard Helix Health to a Dedicated deployment with customer-managed KMS integration. Dedicated provides isolated GPU pools and configurable audit log export that meets Helix's 3-year retention requirement. Should Helix require a private control plane or on-prem HSM, Redwood will execute a migration plan (model artifact parity, KV cache migration, canary traffic cutover) to move from Dedicated to Private. The migration is expected to require 1–2 weeks of ops work plus validation testing; rollback capability will be available for 48 hours post-cutover. Redwood proposes a $15,000 credit applied to the initial Dedicated commitment to cover integration effort."
I'll also attach the ops-runbook snippets and a short migration checklist in the MAP PDF (already included in the files Dylan sent).

Best —
Irene Choi
Solution Architect, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP: Final evaluation checklist & hosting mode escalation — decision timeline

Rachel / team — quick follow to lock timing. Procurement confirmed they have what they need from Irene's paragraph and the MAP PDF. A few operational notes before you sign: 

- If you confirm Dedicated onboarding on Jan 4, we'll provision the dedicated pools on Jan 5 and allocate a staging window Jan 8–10 for smoke tests.
- Security evidence package will be submitted to your compliance mailbox by Jan 3 (includes SOC excerpts, KMS integration docs, and an audit export sample).
- If for any reason the compliance team demands a private control plane after onboarding, the migration window is targeted for Feb 1–7 with a short blackout of up to 2 hours during the DNS cutover.

Please reply with a single line confirmation for: (A) Dedicated start Jan 4; (B) acceptance of $15k credit; (C) final Q1 throughput number. Hoping to close before your internal spend deadline.

Thanks and happy holidays —
Dylan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
